import json,os,subprocess,sys,time,shutil,datetime
from pathlib import Path
out=Path(sys.argv[1]); os.nice(10)
def write(value):
 value['checked_at']=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat()
 p=out/'PIPELINE_STATUS.json'; t=p.with_suffix('.tmp');t.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n');t.replace(p)
def read(path):return json.loads(path.read_text())
try:
 while True:
  state=read(out/'STATUS.json')
  if state['status'] in ('training_completed_evaluation_pending','evaluating'):break
  if state['status']=='failed':raise RuntimeError('Training failed; no evaluation or promotion')
  write(dict(status='waiting_for_matched_training',training=state,pid=os.getpid()))
  coordinator=read(out/'LAUNCH.json')['pid'];os.kill(coordinator,0)
  time.sleep(20)
 state=dict(status='evaluating',checked_at=datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),main_training_modified=False);(out/'STATUS.json').write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2)+'\n')
 commands=[
  [sys.executable,'-m','experiments.offline_camera_retrain_v1.ops','foot-trial','audit','--out',str(out)],
  [sys.executable,'-u','-m','experiments.offline_camera_retrain_v1.ops.foot_trial_evaluation','--out',str(out/'evaluation'),'--models',str(out/'EVALUATION_MODELS.json'),'--memory-fraction','.20'],
  [sys.executable,'-u','-m','experiments.offline_camera_retrain_v1.ops.foot_trial_recheck','--out',str(out/'evaluation'),'--models','parent','control','no_physics']]
 for index,command in enumerate(commands):
  write(dict(status='running',stage=index,command=command,pid=os.getpid()))
  subprocess.run(command,check=True)
 result=dict(status='completed',main_training_modified=False,automatic_promotion=False,free_disk_after_bytes=shutil.disk_usage(out).free,report=str(out/'evaluation/REPORT_zh.md'),cpu_recheck=str(out/'evaluation/CPU_RECHECK_all.json'));write(result);(out/'STATUS.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
except BaseException as exc:
 write(dict(status='failed',error=repr(exc),pid=os.getpid()))
 raise
